unit: Institutes, centers and labs (Mass General Brigham-wide search)
notes: This people_url is a single Mass General Brigham-wide search tool (not BWH-specific) covering the whole MGB system: 606 results total (17 Centers, 31 Departments, 3 Institutes, 555 Labs), paginated 10/page (~61 pages), rendered only via Playwright (static HTML returns an empty shell). No hospital/facility-level filter was found to scope results down to BWH specifically. Fully crawling and attributing all 555 labs to their correct home hospital is a substantial undertaking out of scope for this pass -- recommend a dedicated future pass (ideally shared with mgh-lab-search, which points at the identical tool) that crawls all ~61 pages once and buckets each lab by its home institution/department tag shown on the card.
